purpose: The Train out-of-fold reference is inflated because out-of-fold trials are scored against prototypes built from the same subject's same-session sibling trials; Test trials never are. This makes any Train-calibrated threshold far too strict on Test. Test scale-free score forms that are computed only from Train-derived quantities (per-identity prototype scatter, per-sample distance scale) and see whether the Train->Test shift collapses while the separability survives.
